targets.queryText: SELECT COALESCE(issue, 'unknown') AS issue, run_id, profile, stage, parent_step, scope, reason, ROUND(elapsed_seconds, 1) AS elapsed_seconds, heartbeat_at, liveness, ROUND(heartbeat_age_seconds, 1) AS heartbeat_age_seconds FROM current_execution ORDER BY run_id, stage
